interactive.label: Save
interactive.tooltip: Write the edited account back to the database. A rename also moves your stored session token, so you stay signed in.

interactive.label: Revert
interactive.tooltip: Discard the edits to this account (asks first).

interactive.label: Reload
interactive.tooltip: Fetch the user list again, in the background.

interactive.label: New
interactive.tooltip: Create a new account. Fill in a username and a display name, then press Save.

interactive.label: Delete
interactive.tooltip: Delete the selected account (asks first). Built-in accounts and the active account cannot be deleted.

interactive.label: Password...
interactive.tooltip: Set or change this account's password. It is applied when you Save.

interactive.label: Copy
interactive.tooltip: Copy the rows the table shows now, with the column headers, to the clipboard as tab-separated text.

interactive.label: Export CSV
interactive.tooltip: Write the rows and columns the table shows now to a CSV file.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the table, the account form, passwords and deleting.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through picking an account, editing it and saving.

interactive.label: user_id
interactive.tooltip: How the account is addressed. Changing it renames the account; built-in accounts cannot be renamed.

interactive.label: display_name
interactive.tooltip: The name shown wherever the user appears.

interactive.label: email
interactive.tooltip: Optional contact address.

interactive.label: affiliation
interactive.tooltip: Institution or company.

interactive.label: department
interactive.tooltip: Department or group.

interactive.label: phone
interactive.tooltip: Optional contact number.

interactive.label: website
interactive.tooltip: Optional URL; must start with http:// or https://.

interactive.label: address
interactive.tooltip: Postal address.

interactive.label: details
interactive.tooltip: Free-text notes about the account.

interactive.label: Administrator
interactive.tooltip: Administrators may list, edit and delete users. The server refuses to remove the last one.

interactive.label: Allow sign-in without a password
interactive.tooltip: Convenient on a single-user machine. Administrators may not use it.
